text: Hold hands in silence for 60 seconds. No talking, no phones, eye contact if you can stand it.
Invent a secret handshake with your partner. Four moves minimum, plus one dramatic finish.
Everyone stacks hands in the middle like a team huddle. On three, shout one word that sums up tonight.
Rest your forehead against theirs and breathe together for ten slow breaths.
Rub your partner's shoulders for one full minute. They narrate what's working, like a demanding food critic.
Trace a secret word on their back with one finger. They get three guesses.
Cup their face in both hands and look at them for ten seconds before you say a single word.
Trace their spine through their shirt, top to bottom, as slowly as you can bear.
Kiss them somewhere you've never deliberately kissed before. Announce the location first.
Kiss the inside of their wrist, then stop. They decide where your next kiss lands.
Sit behind them and wrap them up. One kiss on the back of the neck, then just hold on.
Kiss for 30 seconds with both of you keeping your hands behind your backs. Harder than it sounds.
Run your fingers slowly across their scalp and the back of their neck until they make a noise.
Everyone kisses the person on their left anywhere above the collar. The person being kissed picks the spot.
Undress them one item at a time. Kiss each new patch of skin before you move on.
Cover their eyes. Touch them in three places with three different things. They guess what you used.
Slide one hand under their shirt and rest it on their bare back. It stays there until the next card is done.
Kiss your way from their ear to their collarbone. Take at least a full minute to get there.
Ask where they want your hands. Put them there. Stay until they say move.
Match: everyone ditches one item of clothing. Thumbs under the table first.
Undress each other without speaking. Then lie skin to skin for two minutes before anything else happens.
Touch them wherever they ask, however they ask, for three minutes. They give directions; you follow them exactly.
Pour them a glass of water and set it down in front of them without a word. Watch them notice.
Text them a genuine compliment right now, even though they're sitting right there.
Massage their hands, one finger at a time, like each finger has had a very long week.
Leave a note somewhere they'll find it tomorrow. Give zero hints about where.
Buy them one flower this week for no reason at all. Don't explain it. Ever.
Make them their drink of choice exactly how they like it, without asking a single question. Then get graded.
Hand-feed them the last bite of something. Hold eye contact while they chew. Try not to laugh.
Ask which part of their body is tired today. Tend to that spot with your hands for three minutes.
Write down the thing you're proudest of them for. Hand it over. They read it aloud.
Put them to bed tonight: water on the nightstand, covers tucked, one kiss on the forehead.
Give them a full oil massage tonight. No agenda, unless they bring one.
Run them a bath or shower this week, then ask if they'd like company. Bring a towel either way.
Pick out what they'll wear to bed tonight, or decide that it's nothing at all. Their veto stands.
Make up a 30-second song about how you met. A key change is mandatory.
Give a dramatic sports-commentator recap of the first time you two hung out. Slow-motion replays encouraged.
Everyone stands. On three, strike your most heroic album-cover pose and hold it for ten seconds.
Describe your partner like a rare creature in a nature documentary. Hushed narrator voice required.
Do your best impression of them flirting. They get a rebuttal impression of you.
Slow dance with no music. One of you hums. Badly.
Pitch your partner as a dating profile in three sentences. Include one red flag and one green flag.
Everyone tries a pickup line on the person to their right. The table votes the worst; that person earns a Spark.
Reenact your first kiss, playing both parts yourself. Then let them show you what really happened.
Hot or Cold: hide an imaginary kiss somewhere on your body. They hunt for it with their lips while you call hotter or colder.
Perform a slow, sultry striptease of exactly one sock. Full drama, full eye contact, zero irony.
Role-play strangers meeting at a bar for two minutes. Fake names only. Try to get their number.
Match: everyone does their sexiest dance for 30 seconds, all at once, eyes on whoever you like. Thumbs under the table first.
Play Simon Says with your partner for one minute. Simon is feeling bold tonight.
Act out what you'd like to do to them later using only charades. If they guess it, they can claim it.
Give them a real striptease to a song they choose. Stop wherever you like; they can't touch until it ends.
You're in charge for five minutes. Give them three commands; they answer each with 'yes' or 'try again.'
Make up a steamy scene starring you and them and tell it aloud. Keep going until they stop you with a kiss.
Give everyone else at the table the most enthusiastic high five of their lives. Running starts allowed.
Match: everyone swaps one item of clothing with the person to their left for the rest of the game. Thumbs under the table first.
Sit on their lap for the next round. Keep playing like nothing is happening.
Kiss them like it's the last scene of a movie. Swelling music optional; a dip is strongly encouraged.
Take off one item of clothing of your partner's choosing.
Whisper exactly what you want to do to them later. Every detail. Nobody else gets to hear.
Match: everyone makes out with the person to their left for 30 seconds. Thumbs under the table first.
Match: everyone finishes the game in underwear, or less. Thumbs under the table first.
Leave the table with your partner for five minutes. When you come back, report one word only.
Guide their hand to exactly where and how you like to be touched. Narrate. They're taking notes.
Point to a spot below your waistband. They kiss it for a slow count of ten, over clothes or under. Your call.
Strip down to what you'd be brave enough to answer the door in. Stay that way for three turns.
Pass It On: keep this. When you draw a card you'd rather give away, hand it to anyone you like. They play it as if they drew it.
Double Down: the next card anyone plays is worth double Sparks. Make it count.
Cool It: everyone's heat cap drops by one for the next 3 turns. Breathe. Hydrate. Smolder.
Turn It Up: if everyone agrees, the heat cap rises by one for the next 3 turns. One no keeps it where it is.
Steal the Woodpile: take any claimed card from someone else's Woodpile and do it yourself. The Sparks are yours now.
Reverse: the person to your right reads your next card and does it to you. Sit back and receive.
Free Pass: keep this. Play it any time to skip a card and still score 1 Spark. No explanation needed.
Callback: pick any card played tonight and do it again. Full Sparks, encore energy.
Your Rules: invent a card on the spot and play it. The person receiving it chooses the heat.
Truce: everyone gains 3 Sparks and takes a water break. Snacks count too.
